about: Record of evaluations already performed on licensed CRSP data. Committed so that a fresh clone knows which periods are spent. A period/variant listed here can only be re-run with --reproduce, and those runs are labelled reproductions, never fresh evaluations. Results of the original runs are summarised in EXPERIMENTS.md and docs/CORRECTIONS.md.
code_version_note: The original evaluations ran on 2026-11-03 from a working tree before the first commit (2b86276, 2026-11-03 16:06 -0500). The engine was corrected afterwards; see docs/CORRECTIONS.md. Reproductions record the commit they ran on.
